semantics.encode: Head: conv3x3 s2 -> LReLU(0.2) -> conv3x3 -> LReLU -> conv3x3 -> LReLU -> ConvTranspose2d(16, 4, 4, stride 2, pad 1), no trailing activation
semantics.ifblockInput: F.interpolate(x, 1/scale, bilinear, align_corners=False); flow is resized the same way and scaled by 1/scale before concat
semantics.ifblockBody: conv 3x3 s2 -> LReLU(0.2) -> conv 3x3 s2 -> LReLU(0.2) -> 8x ResConv -> ConvTranspose2d(c, 52, 4, stride 2, pad 1) -> PixelShuffle(2)
semantics.resConv: LeakyReLU(0.2)(conv3x3(x) * beta + x); beta is per-output-channel so it can be folded into the weight and bias
semantics.ifblockOutput: F.interpolate(tmp, scale, bilinear); flow = tmp[:, :4] * scale, mask = tmp[:, 4:5], feat = tmp[:, 5:]
semantics.warp: grid_sample(bilinear, padding_mode='border', align_corners=True) with flow normalised by (size - 1) / 2
semantics.accumulation: flow = flow + delta per block; mask is replaced per block; feat is passed forward
semantics.blend: sigmoid(mask) * warp(img0, flow[:, :2]) + (1 - sigmoid(mask)) * warp(img1, flow[:, 2:4])
